record.paper_title: Selected Conjectures and Open Problems on Directed Graphs
record.original_question: Other than the directed cycle of length 4, does there exist a connected sink-free digraph of order n for which every quasi-kernel has size n/2?

evidence.quote: Problem 6.2 Besides a cycle of length 4, is there a connected sink-free digraph such that all its quasi-kernels are of size n 2 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D=(V,A)$ be a finite simple digraph. A vertex $v\in V$ is called a sink if it has out-degree $0$; $D$ is sink-free if it has no sinks. A set $Q\subseteq V$ is independent if there is no arc between any two vertices of $Q$. A quasi-kernel of $D$ is an independent set $Q\subseteq V$ such that every vertex $u\in V\setminus Q$ can reach some vertex of $Q$ by a directed path of length at most $2$. The underlying graph of $D$ is the simple undirected graph obtained by ignoring orientations and multiplicities of arcs; $D$ is connected if its underlying graph is connected.

The directed cycle $\vec{C}_4$ on $4$ vertices is a connected sink-free digraph of order $4$ in which every quasi-kernel has size exactly $2 = n/2$.

Question: Does there exist a connected sink-free digraph $D$ of some order $n$, with $D \not\cong \vec{C}_4$, such that every quasi-kernel of $D$ has size exactly $n/2$?
artifact.status_search_result: A recent survey on the small quasi-kernel conjecture states that disjoint copies of directed 2-cycles and 4-cycles are the only known sink-free digraphs whose smallest quasi-kernel has size at least n/2, and presents only an asymptotic family (hairy regular tournaments) approaching the n/2 bound. No connected sink-free digraph other than the directed 4-cycle is reported in which every quasi-kernel has size exactly n/2, and the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the Small Quasi-kernel conjecture — a survey
status_evidence.snippet: disjoint copies of oriented four-cycles and cycles of length two are the only known directed graphs with no sources that have no QK of size less than half of its vertices
status_evidence.claim: No connected sink-free digraph other than C_4 is known to have all quasi-kernels of size exactly n/2; the question remains open.

status_evidence.title: Results on the Small Quasi-Kernel Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: The small quasi-kernel conjecture of Erdős and Székely (1976) remains open in general; only special classes are settled.
status_evidence.claim: Related extremal questions about quasi-kernel size remain active research problems.
